description:
# Riftborn


We are a growing guild focused on teamwork, consistent progress, and building a strong foundation together.

Whether you're a new adventurer or an experienced player, everyone has a place in Riftborn.

- **Participation:** Active contribution to Guild Challenges is expected.
- **Stockpile:** Every deposit counts toward your contribution and Guild Hall development.
- **Progression:** We grow stronger together, one milestone at a time.
- **Time Zone:** EST (UTC-5)
- **Have Fun!** Enjoy the journey and support your fellow guild members.

---

## ⚡ Current Guild Hall Goal

**Building Our Foundation**

Our journey has just begun! We are working toward unlocking our first Guild Hall upgrades and future features.

Every contribution brings us one step closer.

---

## ⚔️ Guild Raids

**Coming Soon!**

Raids will be organized once the required Guild Hall features are unlocked.

All future raid schedules will follow **EST (UTC-5)**.

Stay active and help us build toward our first raid!

---

## 📋 Guild Contribution Rules

- **Monthly Goal:** 400 contribution points
- **Guild Challenges & Stockpile Deposits:** Both count toward your monthly goal.
- **Guild Raids:** +10 points per raid (once available).
- Requirements may increase as the guild grows.

**🚨 Warning System**
- **Month 1:** 🟨 Yellow Card (First Warning)
- **Month 2:** 🟥 Red Card (Final Warning)
- **Month 3:** ❌ Removal from Guild

**Important:**
- Removal occurs after 3 consecutive months of missed goals.
- Meeting the monthly goal resets all warnings.
- Planning to be away? DM the Guild Leader.
